title: The Book of Romans Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of Romans — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
verses.decoded: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, chosen to be an apostle and set apart to preach God's good news,

verses.kjv: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
verses.decoded: which God promised long ago through his prophets in the holy scriptures,

verses.kjv: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
verses.decoded: about his Son, Jesus Christ our Lord, who was born from the family line of David according to human nature;

verses.kjv: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
verses.decoded: and who was declared to be God's Son with power by the Holy Spirit, shown by his resurrection from the dead.

verses.kjv: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
verses.decoded: Through him we received grace and the role of apostleship to bring all nations to obey the faith for his name's sake.

verses.kjv: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
verses.decoded: And you are among those who are called by Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
verses.decoded: To all in Rome who are loved by God and called to be his holy people: May God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ give you grace and peace.

verses.kjv: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
verses.decoded: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, because your faith is being talked about all over the world.

verses.kjv: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
verses.decoded: God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit as I preach the good news about his Son, that I never stop mentioning you in my prayers.

verses.kjv: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
verses.decoded: I ask that, if it is God's will, I may finally have a good trip to come to you.

verses.kjv: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
verses.decoded: I really want to see you so I can give you some spiritual gift to help you become strong.

verses.kjv: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
verses.decoded: That way, we can encourage each other by sharing the same faith.

verses.kjv: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
verses.decoded: I want you to know, brothers and sisters, that I often planned to visit you, but something always stopped me, so I could have some good results among you, just like I have with other nonJewish people.

verses.kjv: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
verses.decoded: I owe a debt to both Greeks and non-Greeks, to the educated and the uneducated.

verses.kjv: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
verses.decoded: So I am ready to preach the gospel to you in Rome as much as I can.

verses.kjv: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
verses.decoded: I am not ashamed of the gospel about Christ, because it is God's power to save everyone who believes, first the Jew, then the Gentile.

verses.kjv: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
verses.decoded: This gospel shows God's way of making people right with him, which comes from faith to faith, as the scripture says, 'The person who is right with God will live by faith.'

verses.kjv: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
verses.decoded: God's anger is revealed from heaven against all people who do wrong and refuse to live by the truth.

verses.kjv: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
verses.decoded: They know the truth about God because he has shown it to them.

verses.kjv: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
verses.decoded: Since the world was created, God's invisible qualities— his eternal power and divine nature—have been clearly seen in what he made, so people have no excuse.

verses.kjv: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
verses.decoded: Even though they knew God, they did not honor him or thank him. Instead, their thinking became useless and their hearts were darkened.

verses.kjv: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
verses.decoded: Claiming to be wise, they became fools.

verses.kjv: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
verses.decoded: They exchanged the glory of the immortal God for images made to look like mortal humans, birds, animals that walk on four legs, and creatures that crawl.

verses.kjv: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
verses.decoded: So God gave them over to their sinful desires, letting them do shameful things with their bodies.

verses.kjv: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: They traded the truth about God for a lie and worshiped created things instead of the Creator, who is praised forever. Amen.

verses.kjv: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
verses.decoded: Because of this, God let them follow shameful desires. Even their women exchanged natural sexual relations for unnatural ones.

verses.kjv: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
verses.decoded: In the same way, men left natural relations with women and were inflamed with lust for each other. Men committed shameful acts with other men and received in themselves the punishment they deserved.

verses.kjv: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
verses.decoded: Since they refused to acknowledge God, God let them follow their sinful minds and do things they should not do.

verses.kjv: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
verses.decoded: They are full of every kind of wrong—sexual sin, evil, greed, hate, envy, murder, fighting, deceit, and malice. They are gossips,

verses.kjv: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
verses.decoded: slanderers, haters of God, insolent, proud, boastful, inventors of evil, disobedient to parents,

verses.kjv: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
verses.decoded: senseless, untrustworthy, heartless, and merciless.

verses.kjv: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
verses.decoded: Although they know God's justice says those who do these things deserve to die, they not only continue to do them but also approve of others who do them.

verses.kjv: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
verses.decoded: So you have no excuse, whoever you are who judge others. When you judge someone else, you are condemning yourself because you do the same things.

verses.kjv: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
verses.decoded: But we know that God's judgment is true and fair against those who do these things.

verses.kjv: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
verses.decoded: Do you really think, whoever you are who judge those who do these things but do the same yourself, that you will avoid God's judgment?

verses.kjv: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
verses.decoded: Or do you disrespect God's kindness, patience, and tolerance, not realizing that God's kindness is meant to lead you to change your ways?

verses.kjv: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
verses.decoded: But because of your stubbornness and refusal to repent, you are storing up anger for yourself on the day when God's anger and righteous judgment are revealed.

verses.kjv: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
verses.decoded: God will give to each person what they deserve based on what they have done.

verses.kjv: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
verses.decoded: He will give eternal life to those who patiently continue doing good, seeking glory, honor, and immortality.

verses.kjv: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
verses.decoded: But for those who are selfish and refuse to obey the truth, instead obeying evil, there will be anger and punishment.

verses.kjv: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
verses.decoded: There will be trouble and suffering for every person who does evil, first for the Jew and then for the Gentile.

verses.kjv: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
verses.decoded: But glory, honor, and peace will come to everyone who does good, first to the Jew and then to the Gentile.

verses.kjv: For there is no respect of persons with God.
verses.decoded: God does not show favoritism.

verses.kjv: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
verses.decoded: All who have sinned without knowing the law will perish without the law, and all who have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

verses.kjv: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
verses.decoded: It is not those who only hear the law who are right with God, but those who obey the law will be declared right.

verses.kjv: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
verses.decoded: Even Gentiles who do not have the law naturally do what the law requires.

verses.kjv: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
verses.decoded: They show that the law is written in their hearts, and their conscience agrees with them, sometimes accusing them and sometimes defending them.

verses.kjv: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
verses.decoded: This will happen on the day when God judges people's secret thoughts through Jesus Christ, as I have explained in my message.

verses.kjv: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
verses.decoded: You say you are a Jew and depend on the law, and you boast about God.

verses.kjv: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
verses.decoded: You know God's will and approve of what is right because you have been taught the law.

verses.kjv: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
verses.decoded: You are confident that you are a guide for the blind, a light for those in darkness,

verses.kjv: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
verses.decoded: a teacher for those who are foolish, a teacher for children, and you have the knowledge and truth of the law.

verses.kjv: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
verses.decoded: But if you teach others, do you not teach yourself? If you say that people should not steal, do you steal?

verses.kjv: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
verses.decoded: If you say people should not commit adultery, do you commit adultery? If you hate idols, do you rob temples?

verses.kjv: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
verses.decoded: You boast about the law, but by breaking the law you dishonor God.

verses.kjv: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
verses.decoded: As the Scriptures say, God's name is insulted among the Gentiles because of you.

verses.kjv: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
verses.decoded: Circumcision is useful if you obey the law, but if you break the law, your circumcision is worthless.

verses.kjv: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
verses.decoded: So if an uncircumcised person obeys the law, will God count that as circumcision?

verses.kjv: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
verses.decoded: And if an uncircumcised person naturally obeys the law, will they judge you who have the written law and circumcision but still break the law?

verses.kjv: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
verses.decoded: A person is not a Jew just because they are one outwardly, and circumcision is not just an outward physical thing.

verses.kjv: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
verses.decoded: A person is a Jew inwardly, and true circumcision is a matter of the heart, done by the Spirit, not by the written law. Such a person’s praise comes from God, not from people.

verses.kjv: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
verses.decoded: What advantage then does the Jew have? Or what value is there in circumcision?

verses.kjv: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
verses.decoded: There are many advantages, especially that the Jewish people were entrusted with God's messages.

verses.kjv: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
verses.decoded: What if some did not believe? Does their unbelief cancel God's faithfulness?

verses.kjv: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
verses.decoded: Absolutely not! Let God be true, and every person a liar, as it is written: 'So you will be shown to be right when you speak, and you will win when you are judged.'

verses.kjv: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
verses.decoded: But if our sin shows God's righteousness even more clearly, what can we say? Is God unfair to punish us? (I am speaking as a human.)

verses.kjv: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
verses.decoded: Absolutely not! Otherwise, how could God judge the world?

verses.kjv: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
verses.decoded: If my lie makes God's truth shine even more for his glory, why am I still judged as a sinner?

verses.kjv: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
verses.decoded: And why not say, as some slanderously claim we say, 'Let’s do wrong so that good may come'? That punishment is deserved.

verses.kjv: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
verses.decoded: What then? Are we better than they? No, not at all. We have already shown that both Jews and Gentiles are all under sin.

verses.kjv: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
verses.decoded: As it is written, 'There is no one righteous, not even one.'

verses.kjv: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
verses.decoded: There is no one who understands; there is no one who seeks God.

verses.kjv: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
verses.decoded: They have all turned away; they have all become useless. There is no one who does good, not even one.

verses.kjv: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
verses.decoded: Their throats are like open graves; their tongues practice deceit; the poison of vipers is on their lips.

verses.kjv: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
verses.decoded: Their mouths are full of cursing and bitterness.

verses.kjv: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
verses.decoded: Their feet are quick to shed blood.

verses.kjv: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
verses.decoded: Destruction and misery follow them.

verses.kjv: And the way of peace have they not known:
verses.decoded: They do not know the way of peace.

verses.kjv: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
verses.decoded: There is no fear of God before their eyes.

verses.kjv: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
verses.decoded: Now we know that everything the law says is directed to those under the law, so that every mouth may be silenced and the whole world held accountable to God.

verses.kjv: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
verses.decoded: Therefore, no one will be declared right in God's sight by following the law, because the law only shows us our sin.

verses.kjv: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
verses.decoded: But now, apart from the law, God's righteousness has been revealed, and the law and the prophets agree with it.

verses.kjv: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
verses.decoded: This righteousness from God comes through faith in Jesus Christ to all who believe. There is no difference.

verses.kjv: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
verses.decoded: For everyone has sinned and falls short of God's glory.

verses.kjv: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
verses.decoded: But all are made right freely by his grace through the redemption that came by Christ Jesus.

verses.kjv: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
verses.decoded: God presented Christ as a sacrifice to take away sin through faith in his blood. This was to show God's righteousness because of his forgiveness of sins in the past,

verses.kjv: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
verses.decoded: to show that he is fair and that he declares sinners to be right in his sight who believe in Jesus.

verses.kjv: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
verses.decoded: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? The law of works? No, but by the law of faith.

verses.kjv: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
verses.decoded: So we conclude that a person is made right with God through faith, not by following the law.

verses.kjv: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
verses.decoded: Is God only the God of the Jews? Isn't he also the God of the Gentiles? Yes, he is the God of the Gentiles too.

verses.kjv: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
verses.decoded: Since there is only one God, he will make the circumcised right by faith and also the uncircumcised by faith.

verses.kjv: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
verses.decoded: Do we then cancel the law by faith? Absolutely not! Instead, we uphold the law.

verses.kjv: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
verses.decoded: What can we say about Abraham, our ancestor according to the flesh? What did he discover?

verses.kjv: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
verses.decoded: If Abraham was made right by doing good works, he has something to boast about—but not before God.

verses.kjv: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
verses.decoded: What does the scripture say? Abraham believed God, and it was counted to him as righteousness.

verses.kjv: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
verses.decoded: Now, when someone works, their reward is not given as a gift but as something owed.

verses.kjv: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
verses.decoded: But when someone does not work but trusts God who declares the ungodly righteous, their faith is counted as righteousness.

verses.kjv: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
verses.decoded: David also speaks about the happiness of the person to whom God credits righteousness without works,

verses.kjv: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
verses.decoded: saying, 'Happy are those whose wrongs are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.'

verses.kjv: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
verses.decoded: Happy is the person to whom the Lord does not count sin.

verses.kjv: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
verses.decoded: Does this happiness come only to those who are circumcised, or also to those who are not? We say that faith was credited to Abraham as righteousness.

verses.kjv: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
verses.decoded: When was it credited? Was it while Abraham was circumcised, or before? Not while circumcised, but before.

verses.kjv: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
verses.decoded: He received the sign of circumcision as a mark of the righteousness he had by faith while still uncircumcised. He became the father of all who believe without being circumcised, so that righteousness would be credited to them too.

verses.kjv: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
verses.decoded: He is also the father of those who are circumcised, not only for those who are circumcised but also for those who follow the example of the faith Abraham had before he was circumcised.

verses.kjv: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
verses.decoded: The promise that Abraham would inherit the world was not given through the law but through the righteousness that comes by faith.

verses.kjv: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
verses.decoded: If those who follow the law are the heirs, then faith is useless and the promise is worthless.

verses.kjv: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
verses.decoded: The law brings anger because where there is no law, there is no sin.

verses.kjv: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
verses.decoded: So the promise comes by faith, so it may be by grace and guaranteed to all Abraham’s descendants—not only to those who follow the law but also to those who share the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

verses.kjv: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
verses.decoded: As the scripture says, 'I have made you the father of many nations.' This was before God, whom Abraham trusted, the God who gives life to the dead and calls things that do not exist as if they did.

verses.kjv: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
verses.decoded: Against all hope, Abraham believed and hoped that he would become the father of many nations, just as God had said, 'Your descendants will be many.'

verses.kjv: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sara's womb:
verses.decoded: He did not weaken in faith even though his body was nearly dead—he was about 100 years old—and Sarah’s womb was also dead.

verses.kjv: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
verses.decoded: He did not doubt God’s promise because of unbelief but was strong in faith, giving glory to God.

verses.kjv: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
verses.decoded: He was fully convinced that God was able to do what he had promised.

verses.kjv: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
verses.decoded: Because of this, faith was credited to him as righteousness.

verses.kjv: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
verses.decoded: But this was not written only for Abraham’s sake,

verses.kjv: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
verses.decoded: it was written for us too, to whom God will credit righteousness if we believe in the one who raised Jesus our Lord from the dead.

verses.kjv: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
verses.decoded: Jesus was delivered to die for our sins and was raised to life to make us right with God.

verses.kjv: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
verses.decoded: Since we have been made right with God through faith, we now have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ.

verses.kjv: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
verses.decoded: Through him, by faith, we have access to God's grace where we stand, and we are happy because we hope to share in God's glory.

verses.kjv: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
verses.decoded: Not only that, but we also take pride in our troubles, because we know that trouble produces patience;

verses.kjv: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
verses.decoded: patience produces experience; and experience produces hope;

verses.kjv: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
verses.decoded: and hope does not disappoint us, because God's love has been poured into our hearts through the Holy Spirit, who has been given to us.

verses.kjv: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
verses.decoded: When we were weak and powerless, Christ died for those who do not respect God.

verses.kjv: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
verses.decoded: It is rare for someone to die for a good person, though for a truly good person someone might be willing to die.

verses.kjv: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
verses.decoded: But God shows his love for us by the fact that Christ died for us while we were still sinners.

verses.kjv: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
verses.decoded: So now that we have been made right with God by the blood of Christ, we will be saved from God's anger through him.

verses.kjv: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
verses.decoded: If we were enemies of God but were brought back to him through the death of his Son, then how much more will we be saved by the life of Christ now that we are friends with God?

verses.kjv: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
verses.decoded: Not only that, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the gift of being made right with God.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
verses.decoded: This is why, just as sin entered the world through one man, and death came because of sin, death spread to all people because all have sinned.

verses.kjv: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
verses.decoded: Sin was in the world before the law was given, but sin is not counted where there is no law.

verses.kjv: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
verses.decoded: Still, death ruled from the time of Adam to Moses, even over those who did not sin in the same way Adam did. Adam is a symbol of the one who was to come.

verses.kjv: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
verses.decoded: But the gift is not like the sin. If many died because of one man's sin, how much more did God's grace and the gift given through the grace of one man, Jesus Christ, overflow to many!

verses.kjv: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
verses.decoded: The gift is not like the sin. The judgment that came because of one sin led to condemnation, but the free gift leads to being made right with God after many sins.

verses.kjv: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
verses.decoded: If death ruled because of one man's sin, how much more will those who receive God's abundant grace and the gift of righteousness rule in life through Jesus Christ!

verses.kjv: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
verses.decoded: So just as one sin brought judgment and condemnation to all people, one act of righteousness brings the free gift of being made right with God and life to all people.

verses.kjv: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
verses.decoded: Just as many became sinners because one man disobeyed God, many will be made right with God because one man obeyed God.

verses.kjv: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
verses.decoded: The law was given so that sin would increase, but where sin increased, God's grace increased even more.

verses.kjv: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.decoded: So just as sin ruled over people and led to death, now God's grace rules through righteousness and leads to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
verses.decoded: What should we say then? Should we keep sinning so that God's grace can increase?

verses.kjv: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
verses.decoded: Absolutely not. How can we, who have died to sin, continue to live in it?

verses.kjv: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
verses.decoded: Don't you know that all of us who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

verses.kjv: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
verses.decoded: So we were buried with him through baptism into death, in order that just as Christ was raised from the dead by the Father's glory, we too may live a new life.

verses.kjv: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
verses.decoded: If we have been united with him in his death, we will also be united with him in his resurrection.

verses.kjv: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
verses.decoded: We know that our old self was crucified with him so that our sinful body might be destroyed, and we would no longer be slaves to sin.

verses.kjv: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
verses.decoded: Anyone who has died is freed from sin.

verses.kjv: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
verses.decoded: Now if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him.

verses.kjv: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
verses.decoded: We know that Christ, having been raised from the dead, will never die again; death no longer has power over him.

verses.kjv: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
verses.decoded: When he died, he died to sin once for all; but now that he lives, he lives for God.

verses.kjv: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.decoded: In the same way, consider yourselves dead to sin but alive to God through Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
verses.decoded: So do not let sin control your mortal body to make you obey its desires.

verses.kjv: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
verses.decoded: Do not offer any part of yourself to sin as a tool for doing wrong. Instead, offer yourselves to God as those who have been brought from death to life, and offer every part of yourself to him as a tool for doing what is right.

verses.kjv: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
verses.decoded: Sin will not control you because you are not under the law but under God's grace.

verses.kjv: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
verses.decoded: What then? Should we sin because we are not under the law but under grace? Absolutely not.

verses.kjv: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
verses.decoded: Don't you know that when you offer yourselves to someone as obedient slaves, you are slaves to the one you obey? You can be slaves to sin, which leads to death, or to obedience, which leads to righteousness.

verses.kjv: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
verses.decoded: But thank God that although you used to be slaves to sin, you have obeyed from your heart the teaching you were given.

verses.kjv: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
verses.decoded: Now that you have been set free from sin, you have become slaves to righteousness.

verses.kjv: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
verses.decoded: I am speaking in human terms because of your weak human nature. Just as you once gave yourselves as slaves to impurity and to greater and greater sin, now give yourselves as slaves to righteousness leading to holiness.

verses.kjv: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
verses.decoded: When you were slaves to sin, you were free from the control of righteousness.

verses.kjv: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
verses.decoded: What benefit did you get from the things you are now ashamed of? The end result of those things is death.

verses.kjv: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
verses.decoded: But now that you have been set free from sin and have become slaves to God, the benefit you get leads to holiness, and the result is eternal life.

verses.kjv: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
verses.decoded: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life through Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
verses.decoded: Don't you know, brothers and sisters, (I am speaking to those who understand the law,) that the law has authority over a person only as long as that person lives?

verses.kjv: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
verses.decoded: For a woman who has a husband is legally bound to him as long as he lives; but if her husband dies, she is free from the law that binds her to him.

verses.kjv: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
verses.decoded: So if, while her husband is alive, she marries another man, she is called an adulteress; but if her husband dies, she is free from that law and is not an adulteress if she marries another man.

verses.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
verses.decoded: In the same way, my brothers and sisters, you also died to the law through the body of Christ, so that you could be joined to another, to the one who was raised from the dead, in order to produce fruit for God.

verses.kjv: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
verses.decoded: When we lived in the flesh, the sinful desires aroused by the law were active in us, producing fruit that leads to death.

verses.kjv: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
verses.decoded: But now we have been released from the law, having died to what held us captive, so that we serve in the new way of the Spirit, not in the old way of the written code.

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
verses.decoded: What shall we say then? Is the law sinful? Absolutely not! In fact, I would not have known what sin was except through the law. I would not have known what it means to desire something wrong if the law had not said, 'You shall not covet.'

verses.kjv: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
verses.decoded: But sin used the commandment to produce all kinds of wrong desires in me. Without the law, sin is dead.

verses.kjv: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
verses.decoded: I was once alive without the law, but when the commandment came, sin came alive and I died.

verses.kjv: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
verses.decoded: The commandment that was meant to bring life actually brought death to me.

verses.kjv: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
verses.decoded: Sin used the commandment to deceive me and kill me.

verses.kjv: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
verses.decoded: So the law is holy, and the commandment is holy, right, and good.

verses.kjv: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
verses.decoded: Did something good become the cause of my death? Absolutely not! But sin used what is good to show itself as sin by causing death in me through what is good, so that sin would become very sinful through the commandment.

verses.kjv: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
verses.decoded: We know that the law is spiritual, but I am a person controlled by sinful nature, sold as a slave to sin.

verses.kjv: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
verses.decoded: What I do, I do not understand. I do not do what I want, but I do what I hate.

verses.kjv: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
verses.decoded: If I do what I do not want, I agree that the law is good.

verses.kjv: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.decoded: So now it is not me doing it, but sin living in me.

verses.kjv: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
verses.decoded: I know that nothing good lives in me, that is, in my sinful nature. I want to do good, but I cannot carry it out.

verses.kjv: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
verses.decoded: What I want to do, I do not do; but what I hate, I do.

verses.kjv: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
verses.decoded: If I do what I do not want, it is no longer I who do it, but sin living in me.

verses.kjv: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
verses.decoded: So I find this law at work: When I want to do good, evil is right there with me.

verses.kjv: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
verses.decoded: I delight in God's law in my inner being.

verses.kjv: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
verses.decoded: But I see another law at work in my body, fighting against the law of my mind and making me a prisoner to the law of sin at work in my body.

verses.kjv: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
verses.decoded: What a miserable person I am! Who will rescue me from this body that is subject to death?

verses.kjv: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
verses.decoded: Thank God! He will rescue me through Jesus Christ our Lord. So with my mind I serve the law of God, but with my sinful nature I serve the law of sin.

verses.kjv: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.decoded: So now there is no condemnation for those who belong to Christ Jesus and live by the Spirit, not by their sinful nature.

verses.kjv: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
verses.decoded: The power of the Spirit who gives life through Christ Jesus has freed me from the power of sin and death.

verses.kjv: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
verses.decoded: What the law could not do because it was weak through our sinful nature, God did by sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh to deal with sin and condemn it in the flesh.

verses.kjv: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
verses.decoded: This was so that the righteous requirements of the law might be fully met in us who live by the Spirit, not by the sinful nature.

verses.kjv: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
verses.decoded: Those who live according to the sinful nature think about sinful things, but those who live by the Spirit think about spiritual things.

verses.kjv: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
verses.decoded: Thinking only about the sinful nature leads to death, but thinking by the Spirit leads to life and peace.

verses.kjv: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
verses.decoded: The sinful mind is hostile to God because it does not submit to God's law and cannot do so.

verses.kjv: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
verses.decoded: Those who are controlled by the sinful nature cannot please God.

verses.kjv: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
verses.decoded: But you are not controlled by the sinful nature; you are controlled by the Spirit if God's Spirit lives in you. If anyone does not have the Spirit of Christ, they do not belong to him.

verses.kjv: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
verses.decoded: If Christ lives in you, even though your body is subject to death because of sin, the Spirit gives life because of righteousness.

verses.kjv: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
verses.decoded: And if the Spirit of the one who raised Jesus from the dead lives in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit living in you.

verses.kjv: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
verses.decoded: So, brothers and sisters, we are not obligated to live according to the sinful nature.

verses.kjv: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
verses.decoded: If you live by the sinful nature, you will die, but if by the Spirit you put to death the actions of the body, you will live.

verses.kjv: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
verses.decoded: Those who are led by God's Spirit are God's children.

verses.kjv: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
verses.decoded: You have not received a spirit that makes you a slave again to fear, but you have received the Spirit that makes you God's child, and by him we cry, 'Abba, Father.'

verses.kjv: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
verses.decoded: The Spirit himself confirms with our spirit that we are God's children.

verses.kjv: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
verses.decoded: And if we are God's children, then we are his heirs. We are heirs of God and co-heirs with Christ, if we share in his sufferings so that we may also share in his glory.

verses.kjv: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
verses.decoded: I consider that our present sufferings are not worth comparing with the glory that will be revealed in us.

verses.kjv: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
verses.decoded: The whole creation eagerly waits for the day when God's children will be revealed.

verses.kjv: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
verses.decoded: Creation was subjected to frustration, not by its own choice, but by God's will, with the hope

verses.kjv: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
verses.decoded: that creation itself will be set free from its slavery to decay and brought into the freedom and glory of God's children.

verses.kjv: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
verses.decoded: We know that all creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

verses.kjv: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
verses.decoded: Not only so, but we ourselves, who have the firstfruits of the Spirit, groan inwardly as we wait eagerly for our bodies to be set free.

verses.kjv: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
verses.decoded: For in this hope we were saved. But hope that is seen is no hope at all, because who hopes for what they already have?

verses.kjv: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
verses.decoded: But if we hope for what we do not yet have, we wait for it patiently.

verses.kjv: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
verses.decoded: In the same way, the Spirit helps us in our weakness. We do not know what we ought to pray for, but the Spirit himself intercedes for us with groans that words cannot express.

verses.kjv: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
verses.decoded: And he who searches our hearts knows the mind of the Spirit, because the Spirit intercedes for God's people in accordance with God's will.

verses.kjv: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
verses.decoded: And we know that in all things God works for the good of those who love him, who have been called according to his purpose.

verses.kjv: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
verses.decoded: For those God foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, so that he would be the firstborn among many brothers and sisters.

verses.kjv: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
verses.decoded: And those he predestined, he also called; those he called, he also justified; those he justified, he also glorified.

verses.kjv: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
verses.decoded: So what can we say about all this? If God is for us, who can be against us?

verses.kjv: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
verses.decoded: He did not spare his own Son but gave him up for all of us. Won't he also freely give us everything else?

verses.kjv: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
verses.decoded: Who can accuse God's chosen people? God is the one who declares them not guilty.

verses.kjv: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
verses.decoded: Who can condemn them? Christ died and even rose again. He is at God's right hand and is also praying for us.

verses.kjv: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
verses.decoded: Who can separate us from Christ's love? Trouble, hardship, persecution, hunger, nakedness, danger, or violence?

verses.kjv: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
verses.decoded: As the scripture says, 'For your sake we are killed every day; we are treated like sheep being led to the slaughter.'

verses.kjv: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
verses.decoded: No, in all these things we are more than winners because of him who loved us.

verses.kjv: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
verses.decoded: I am sure that nothing—death or life, angels or rulers, present things or future things,

verses.kjv: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
verses.decoded: height or depth, or anything else in all creation—can separate us from the love of God that is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

verses.kjv: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
verses.decoded: I am telling the truth in Christ. I am not lying. My conscience agrees with me by the Holy Spirit.

verses.kjv: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
verses.decoded: I have great sadness and constant sorrow in my heart.

verses.kjv: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
verses.decoded: I wish I could be cursed and separated from Christ if it would help my brothers, my relatives by blood.

verses.kjv: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
verses.decoded: They are Israelites. They belong to the group God chose, have the glory, the agreements, the law, the worship of God, and the promises.

verses.kjv: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
verses.decoded: They are the descendants of the fathers, and from them, as far as human nature goes, Christ came, who is God over all, forever blessed. Amen.

verses.kjv: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
verses.decoded: It is not that God's word has failed. Not all who are descended from Israel are truly Israel.

verses.kjv: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
verses.decoded: And not all children of Abraham are his true children. It is through Isaac that your descendants will be counted.

verses.kjv: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.
verses.decoded: This means those who are born naturally are not God's children, but those who are children of the promise are counted as descendants.

verses.kjv: For this is the word of promise, At this time will I come, and Sara shall have a son.
verses.decoded: This is what the promise said: 'At this time I will come, and Sarah will have a son.'

verses.kjv: And not only this; but when Rebecca also had conceived by one, even by our father Isaac;
verses.decoded: Not only that, but when Rebecca also became pregnant by one man, our father Isaac,

verses.kjv: (For the children being not yet born, neither having done any good or evil, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth;)
verses.decoded: before the children were born and had done anything good or bad, so God's choice would stand, not based on works but on the one who calls,

verses.kjv: It was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.
verses.decoded: it was said to her, 'The older will serve the younger.'

verses.kjv: As it is written, Jacob have I loved, but Esau have I hated.
verses.decoded: As it is written, 'I loved Jacob, but I hated Esau.'

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.
verses.decoded: What can we say then? Is God unfair? Absolutely not!

verses.kjv: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I will have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I will have compassion.
verses.decoded: He said to Moses, 'I will show mercy to whom I choose, and I will have compassion on whom I choose.'

verses.kjv: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that sheweth mercy.
verses.decoded: So it does not depend on human desire or effort, but on God's mercy.

verses.kjv: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, Even for this same purpose have I raised thee up, that I might shew my power in thee, and that my name might be declared throughout all the earth.
verses.decoded: For the scripture says to Pharaoh, 'I raised you up for this very reason, to show my power through you and to spread my name across the earth.'

verses.kjv: Therefore hath he mercy on whom he will have mercy, and whom he will he hardeneth.
verses.decoded: So God shows mercy to whoever he wants and hardens whoever he wants.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he yet find fault? For who hath resisted his will?
verses.decoded: You might ask me, 'Why does God still blame people? Who can oppose his will?'

verses.kjv: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why hast thou made me thus?
verses.decoded: But who are you to argue with God? Does the thing made say to its maker, 'Why did you make me like this?'

verses.kjv: Hath not the potter power over the clay, of the same lump to make one vessel unto honour, and another unto dishonour?
verses.decoded: Doesn't the potter have the right to make some pots for honorable use and others for common use?

verses.kjv: What if God, willing to shew his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering the vessels of wrath fitted to destruction:
verses.decoded: What if God, wanting to show his anger and power, patiently endured the objects made for destruction?

verses.kjv: And that he might make known the riches of his glory on the vessels of mercy, which he had afore prepared unto glory,
verses.decoded: And he did this to show the riches of his glory on the objects of mercy, which he prepared in advance for glory—

verses.kjv: Even us, whom he hath called, not of the Jews only, but also of the Gentiles?
verses.decoded: including us, whom he called, not only from the Jews but also from the Gentiles?

verses.kjv: As he saith also in Osee, I will call them my people, which were not my people; and her beloved, which was not beloved.
verses.decoded: As Hosea said, 'I will call those who were not my people my people, and I will love those who were not loved.'

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, that in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people; there shall they be called the children of the living God.
verses.decoded: And it will happen that in the place where they were told, 'You are not my people,' they will be called children of the living God.

verses.kjv: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:
verses.decoded: Isaiah also says about Israel, 'Though the number of Israel's children is like the sand of the sea, only a remnant will be saved.'

verses.kjv: For he will finish the work, and cut it short in righteousness: because a short work will the Lord make upon the earth.
verses.decoded: The Lord will finish the work quickly and do it in righteousness because he will make a short work on the earth.

verses.kjv: And as Esaias said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, we had been as Sodoma, and been made like unto Gomorrha.
verses.decoded: As Isaiah said before, 'If the Lord of Heaven's Armies had not left us a few survivors, we would be like Sodom and Gomorrah.'

verses.kjv: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, which followed not after righteousness, have attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith.
verses.decoded: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who did not try to get righteousness, have received it by faith.

verses.kjv: But Israel, which followed after the law of righteousness, hath not attained to the law of righteousness.
verses.decoded: But Israel, who tried to get righteousness by following the law, did not succeed.

verses.kjv: Wherefore? Because they sought it not by faith, but as it were by the works of the law. For they stumbled at that stumblingstone;
verses.decoded: Why? Because they did not seek it by faith, but as if it were by following the law. They stumbled over that stumbling stone;

verses.kjv: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.decoded: As it is written, 'Look, I place a stone in Zion that causes people to stumble and a rock that makes them fall; but anyone who believes in him will never be ashamed.'

verses.kjv: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.
verses.decoded: Brothers, my deepest wish and prayer to God is that Israel might be saved.

verses.kjv: For I bear them record that they have a zeal of God, but not according to knowledge.
verses.decoded: I can testify that they have a strong passion for God, but it is not based on true knowledge.

verses.kjv: For they being ignorant of God's righteousness, and going about to establish their own righteousness, have not submitted themselves unto the righteousness of God.
verses.decoded: They don’t understand God’s way of being right, and they try to make themselves right by their own efforts, but they have not submitted to God’s way of being right.

verses.kjv: For Christ is the end of the law for righteousness to every one that believeth.
verses.decoded: Christ is the goal of the law so that everyone who believes will be made right.

verses.kjv: For Moses describeth the righteousness which is of the law, That the man which doeth those things shall live by them.
verses.decoded: Moses describes the kind of rightness the law requires: The person who obeys those laws will live by them.

verses.kjv: But the righteousness which is of faith speaketh on this wise, Say not in thine heart, Who shall ascend into heaven? (that is, to bring Christ down from above:)
verses.decoded: But the rightness that comes from faith says this: Don’t say in your heart, ‘Who will go up to heaven?’ (to bring Christ down from above),

verses.kjv: Or, Who shall descend into the deep? (that is, to bring up Christ again from the dead.)
verses.decoded: or, ‘Who will go down into the deep?’ (to bring Christ up from the dead).

verses.kjv: But what saith it? The word is nigh thee, even in thy mouth, and in thy heart: that is, the word of faith, which we preach;
verses.decoded: But what does it say? The message is very close to you, in your mouth and in your heart—that is, the message of faith we preach.

verses.kjv: That if thou shalt confess with thy mouth the Lord Jesus, and shalt believe in thine heart that God hath raised him from the dead, thou shalt be saved.
verses.decoded: If you openly declare that Jesus is Lord and believe in your heart that God raised him from the dead, you will be saved.

verses.kjv: For with the heart man believeth unto righteousness; and with the mouth confession is made unto salvation.
verses.decoded: People believe with their hearts and are made right with God, and they confess with their mouths and are saved.

verses.kjv: For the scripture saith, Whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
verses.decoded: The scripture says, Whoever believes in him will never be ashamed.

verses.kjv: For there is no difference between the Jew and the Greek: for the same Lord over all is rich unto all that call upon him.
verses.decoded: There is no difference between Jew and Greek, because the same Lord is Lord of all and is generous to all who call on him.

verses.kjv: For whosoever shall call upon the name of the Lord shall be saved.
verses.decoded: Anyone who calls on the Lord’s name will be saved.

verses.kjv: How then shall they call on him in whom they have not believed? and how shall they believe in him of whom they have not heard? and how shall they hear without a preacher?
verses.decoded: But how can they call on him if they have not believed in him? And how can they believe if they have not heard about him? And how can they hear without someone preaching to them?

verses.kjv: And how shall they preach, except they be sent? as it is written, How beautiful are the feet of them that preach the gospel of peace, and bring glad tidings of good things!
verses.decoded: And how can anyone preach unless they are sent? As the scripture says, How beautiful are the feet of those who bring good news of peace and bring good news of happiness!

verses.kjv: But they have not all obeyed the gospel. For Esaias saith, Lord, who hath believed our report?
verses.decoded: But not everyone has obeyed the good news. Isaiah says, Lord, who has believed what we have reported?

verses.kjv: So then faith cometh by hearing, and hearing by the word of God.
verses.decoded: So faith comes from hearing the message, and the message is heard through the word about Christ.

verses.kjv: But I say, Have they not heard? Yes verily, their sound went into all the earth, and their words unto the ends of the world.
verses.decoded: But I ask, Have they not heard? Yes, their message has gone everywhere in the world, and their words have reached the ends of the earth.

verses.kjv: But I say, Did not Israel know? First Moses saith, I will provoke you to jealousy by them that are no people, and by a foolish nation I will anger you.
verses.decoded: But I ask, Did Israel not understand? First Moses says, I will make you jealous by those who are not a nation, and I will anger you by a foolish nation.

verses.kjv: But Esaias is very bold, and saith, I was found of them that sought me not; I was made manifest unto them that asked not after me.
verses.decoded: But Isaiah is very bold and says, I was found by those who did not seek me; I was made known to those who did not ask for me.

verses.kjv: I say then, Hath God cast away his people? God forbid. For I also am an Israelite, of the seed of Abraham, of the tribe of Benjamin.
verses.decoded: So I ask, has God rejected his people? Absolutely not. I am also an Israelite, a descendant of Abraham, from the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: God hath not cast away his people which he foreknew. Wot ye not what the scripture saith of Elias? how he maketh intercession to God against Israel, saying,
verses.decoded: God has not rejected the people he knew from the start. Don’t you know what the scripture says about Elijah? How he prayed to God against Israel, saying,

verses.kjv: Lord, they have killed thy prophets, and digged down thine altars; and I am left alone, and they seek my life.
verses.decoded: 'Lord, they have killed your prophets and torn down your altars. I am the only one left, and they want to kill me too.'

verses.kjv: But what saith the answer of God unto him? I have reserved to myself seven thousand men, who have not bowed the knee to the image of Baal.
verses.decoded: But what was God’s answer to him? 'I have kept for myself seven thousand men who have never bowed down to Baal’s statue.'

verses.kjv: Even so then at this present time also there is a remnant according to the election of grace.
verses.decoded: So even now, there is a small group chosen by God’s grace.

verses.kjv: And if by grace, then is it no more of works: otherwise grace is no more grace. But if it be of works, then is it no more grace: otherwise work is no more work.
verses.decoded: And if it is by grace, then it is not by works; otherwise grace would not be grace. But if it is by works, then it is not grace; otherwise work would not be work.

verses.kjv: What then? Israel hath not obtained that which he seeketh for; but the election hath obtained it, and the rest were blinded
verses.decoded: What then? Israel did not get what they were looking for, but those chosen by God did, and the rest were made blind.

verses.kjv: (According as it is written, God hath given them the spirit of slumber, eyes that they should not see, and ears that they should not hear;) unto this day.
verses.decoded: (As it is written, God has given them a spirit that makes them sleepy, eyes that cannot see, and ears that cannot hear) until today.

verses.kjv: And David saith, Let their table be made a snare, and a trap, and a stumblingblock, and a recompence unto them:
verses.decoded: And David says, 'Let their table become a trap, a snare, a cause for falling, and a punishment for them.'

verses.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they may not see, and bow down their back alway.
verses.decoded: Let their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and always bend their backs.

verses.kjv: I say then, Have they stumbled that they should fall? God forbid: but rather through their fall salvation is come unto the Gentiles, for to provoke them to jealousy.
verses.decoded: I ask then, did they stumble so badly that they fell completely? Absolutely not. Instead, because they stumbled, salvation has come to the Gentiles to make Israel jealous.

verses.kjv: Now if the fall of them be the riches of the world, and the diminishing of them the riches of the Gentiles; how much more their fulness?
verses.decoded: If their failure brought riches to the world, and their loss brought riches to the Gentiles, how much more will their full return bring?

verses.kjv: For I speak to you Gentiles, inasmuch as I am the apostle of the Gentiles, I magnify mine office:
verses.decoded: I am speaking to you Gentiles. Since I am the apostle to the Gentiles, I am proud of my work.

verses.kjv: If by any means I may provoke to emulation them which are my flesh, and might save some of them.
verses.decoded: If I can, I want to make my own people jealous and save some of them.

verses.kjv: For if the casting away of them be the reconciling of the world, what shall the receiving of them be, but life from the dead?
verses.decoded: If rejecting them brought the world back to God, what will accepting them again be but life from the dead?

verses.kjv: For if the firstfruit be holy, the lump is also holy: and if the root be holy, so are the branches.
verses.decoded: If the first part of the harvest is holy, then the whole batch is holy. And if the root is holy, the branches are too.

verses.kjv: And if some of the branches be broken off, and thou, being a wild olive tree, wert graffed in among them, and with them partakest of the root and fatness of the olive tree;
verses.decoded: If some branches were broken off, and you, a wild olive tree, were grafted in among them and share in the root and rich sap of the olive tree,

verses.kjv: Boast not against the branches. But if thou boast, thou bearest not the root, but the root thee.
verses.decoded: don’t brag against the branches. If you do, remember that you don’t support the root; the root supports you.

verses.kjv: Thou wilt say then, The branches were broken off, that I might be graffed in.
verses.decoded: You might say, 'The branches were broken off so I could be grafted in.'

verses.kjv: Well; because of unbelief they were broken off, and thou standest by faith. Be not highminded, but fear:
verses.decoded: That’s true. They were broken off because of unbelief, but you stand by faith. Don’t be proud, but respect God.

verses.kjv: For if God spared not the natural branches, take heed lest he also spare not thee.
verses.decoded: If God didn’t spare the natural branches, be careful that he doesn’t spare you either.

verses.kjv: Behold therefore the goodness and severity of God: on them which fell, severity; but toward thee, goodness, if thou continue in his goodness: otherwise thou also shalt be cut off.
verses.decoded: Think about God’s kindness and strictness: strictness to those who fell, but kindness to you—if you continue in his kindness. Otherwise, you will be cut off too.

verses.kjv: And they also, if they abide not still in unbelief, shall be graffed in: for God is able to graff them in again.
verses.decoded: And they can be grafted in again if they don’t continue in unbelief, because God can graft them in again.

verses.kjv: For if thou wert cut out of the olive tree which is wild by nature, and wert graffed contrary to nature into a good olive tree: how much more shall these, which be the natural branches, be graffed into their own olive tree?
verses.decoded: If you were cut off from a wild olive tree and grafted into a good olive tree against nature, how much more will these natural branches be grafted into their own olive tree?

verses.kjv: For I would not, brethren, that ye should be ignorant of this mystery, lest ye should be wise in your own conceits; that blindness in part is happened to Israel, until the fulness of the Gentiles be come in.
verses.decoded: I don’t want you to be unaware of this mystery, brothers: Israel has been partially blinded until the full number of Gentiles comes in.

verses.kjv: And so all Israel shall be saved: as it is written, There shall come out of Sion the Deliverer, and shall turn away ungodliness from Jacob:
verses.decoded: And then all Israel will be saved, as it is written: 'The Deliverer will come from Zion and will turn away ungodliness from Jacob.'

verses.kjv: For this is my covenant unto them, when I shall take away their sins.
verses.decoded: This is the covenant I will make with them when I take away their sins.

verses.kjv: As concerning the gospel, they are enemies for your sakes: but as touching the election, they are beloved for the fathers' sakes.
verses.decoded: Regarding the gospel, they are enemies because of you, but regarding God’s choice, they are loved because of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.
verses.decoded: God’s gifts and his call cannot be changed.

verses.kjv: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
verses.decoded: Just as you once did not believe God, but now have received mercy because of their unbelief,

verses.kjv: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
verses.decoded: In the same way, they have not believed yet, so that by your kindness they may also receive kindness.

verses.kjv: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
verses.decoded: God has put everyone into unbelief so that he can show kindness to all.

verses.kjv: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
